findings.title: include_website_name predicate is missing the required question mark
findings.body: The serializer defines `include_website_name` without a trailing `?`, while ActiveModelSerializers and every other conditional in this serializer (e.g. `include_email?`, `include_card_image_badge_id?`) invoke `include_<attribute>?`. This method is therefore never called, so `website_name` is serialized as null for users without a website instead of being omitted when `website` is blank.

findings.title: website_name bypasses the untrusted-attributes restriction for TL0 users
findings.body: `website` is listed in `untrusted_attributes`, so it is hidden from anonymous viewers when `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` applies to a TL0 user, but the newly added `website_name` attribute is not added to that list. Anonymous viewers will consequently receive the website host and, in the matching-domain case, its full path even though the website itself is supposed to be hidden, and the untrusted-attributes spec was not updated to cover `website_name`.

findings.title: Same-domain detection is asymmetric when the website is a subdomain of the instance
findings.body: The logic handles an instance that is a subdomain of the website (e.g. instance `forums.example.com`, website `example.com/user` returns `example.com/user`) and equal-depth siblings, but not the reverse: with instance `example.com` and website `http://www.example.com/user` or `http://blog.example.com/user`, the lengths differ, the equal-length branch is skipped, and `example.com.ends_with?('.www.example.com')` is false, so only the host is returned and the path is discarded despite the website sharing the instance's domain.

findings.title: No spec covers the sibling-subdomain branch of website_name
findings.body: The new specs cover only an unrelated domain, an exact host match, and a website that is the parent of the instance host. They do not exercise the distinct equal-depth sibling branch in the serializer (e.g. website `www.example.com/user` with instance `forum.example.com`, which should return `www.example.com/user`, and a same-depth host on a different registrable domain, which should not), so that branch's first-label-stripping comparison can regress unnoticed.
